title: 시작하기 전
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop City Pop track in G Major at 110 BPM. The arrangement features a clean, funk-influenced electric guitar playing syncopated 16th-note rhythms and a slap bass line that follows the kick drum pattern. A bright, polyphonic analog synth pad provides harmonic backing while a secondary synth lead plays staccato melodic fills. The drums consist of a crisp snare on 2 and 4, a tight kick drum, and consistent 16th-note hi-hat patterns. Female vocals are delivered in a smooth, conversational alto range with light doubling in the chorus. Production includes subtle chorus effects on the guitar and a gated reverb on the snare.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
